trace.question: Among the users located in United Kingdom, how many users whose post have a total favorite amount of 4 or more?
trace.evidence: favorite amount of 4 or more refers to FavoriteCount > = 4; Location = 'United Kingdom';

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
    WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING SUM(p.FavoriteCount) >= 4
) AS qualifying_users

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
    WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING SUM(p.FavoriteCount) >= 4
) AS qualifying_users
trace.answer: There are 18 users located in the United Kingdom whose posts have a total favorite count of 4 or more.
